raw_segments.text: I see the difficulty," I replied, yet the fostering of such a belief will make them
care more for the city and for one another.
Enough, however, of the fiction, which may now fly abroad upon the wings of rumor, while
we arm our earth-born heroes and lead them forth under the command of their rulers.
Let them look round and select a spot whence they can best suppress insurrection, if any
prove refractory within, and also defend themselves against enemies, who like wolves may come
down on the fold from without.
